title: Xbox Game Pass Playtime Drift
app: Jellyfin, Emby, Steam, Steam Deck logs, Xbox and Nintendo exports, Tautulli, AntennaPod, RetroArch, and the *arr stack via official APIs, local databases, webhook payloads, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=xbox:activity
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(minutes_played) as minutes_played by title _time
| streamstats current=f avg(minutes_played) as baseline_minutes by title
| where baseline_minutes>0 AND minutes_played<baseline_minutes*0.5
| sort minutes_played
description: Uses Xbox activity exports telemetry to monitor monthly playtime against the recent title baseline in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for games that fell out of rotation after install, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Xbox activity exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Monthly title chart of playtime versus baseline.
grandmaExplanation: It flags monthly playtime against the recent title baseline so you can spot games that fell out of rotation after install before it becomes annoying.
